purpose: Run the canonical mailing pipeline from the beginning, stage by stage, stopping at the first slow, erroneous, ambiguous, or policy-noncompliant stage so that the bottleneck can be analyzed and fixed before the next full restart.

execution.on_time_limit: Stop as soon as safely possible; do not start another candidate, lookup, chunk, or sub-operation after the limit is known to be exceeded. Report processed and remaining counts.

pass_requires: all_required assertions for the stage are proven
elapsed time does not exceed the active stage limit
no canonical policy rule was bypassed

standard_stage_report.candidate_names_in_progress: forbidden unless necessary to explain the exact failing row in a requested debug report

stages.name: Canonical policy bootstrap
requirements: config/mailing_policy.json is the first substantive repository content loaded for the run
policy status is canonical
policy structure is readable
record exact policy version and blob SHA

stages.name: Canonical taste profile load
requirements: load gaming_taste_live.json exactly once
record exact Git blob SHA
do not use historical snapshot as fallback
wishlist is context only and not taste proof

stages.name: Production feed ingest and QA
requirements: validate production manifest and chosen source index
prefer mailing optimized view only when canonical ingest QA allows it
read every chosen chunk
prove actual chunk count equals index
prove actual rows equal item_count
prove optimized/source lossless invariants when optimized view is chosen

stages.name: Taste cache load and structural validation
requirements: load data/cache/taste_fit.json at most once
validate schema and entry_count against len(entries)
record current profile SHA and taste model version
do not classify any entry as hit until exact cache-hit requirements are proven

stages.name: Optional recovery artifact validation
requirements: validate recovery artifact only if present
apply canonical full or partial recovery rules exactly
invalid artifact is ignored rather than guessed valid
no semantic reevaluation of valid recovered final entries

stages.name: Price-blind fingerprint schema test
requirements: reconstruct fingerprint using only canonical fingerprint_fields
prove excluded price/review/feed/deal/history fields are absent
normalization and sorting are deterministic

stages.name: Full taste-cache fingerprint validation
requirements: mechanically validate every current feed candidate
cache hit requires exact key + exact profile SHA + exact taste model version + exact taste fingerprint
classify every candidate as hit or miss/stale without extrapolation
hits + misses_or_stale equals full feed count

stages.name: Semantic taste evaluation for true misses only
requirements: never semantically reevaluate confirmed hits
process misses in canonical feed chunk order
use taste-v2 evidence contract
taste evidence remains price-blind
track exact evaluated count

stages.name: Targeted price-blind false-negative audit
requirements: audit only canonical audit triggers
same evidence threshold as first pass
no external lookups
record exact EXCLUDE to INCLUDE changes

stages.name: Final price-blind taste ledger
requirements: every ingested candidate has final INCLUDE or EXCLUDE
include has fit level
exclude has specific canonical reason code
included + excluded equals processed
all current candidates have final non-ambiguous taste state before downstream

stages.name: Mandatory taste checkpoint
requirements: follow canonical incremental checkpoint strategy
persist changed final non-borderline entries before downstream
zero writes is valid only when there are provably zero required cache changes
checkpoint status is explicitly proven before content/store/SteamDB stages

stages.name: Content eligibility and DLC/addon filtering
requirements: apply canonical DLC/chapter eligibility
exclude cosmetic/soundtrack/artbook/non-game addons
wishlist is not ownership proof
record exact eligible and excluded counts

stages.name: Purchase-family resolution
requirements: group before expensive external checks
do not merge merely by shared franchise word
compare local variants within included family
prepare one primary output row per family

stages.name: Current-state resolution from snapshot/store cache and conditional Store
requirements: load store_state at most once
validated production snapshot remains primary current price/discount source
live Store only on canonical triggers
lookup registry prevents duplicates
record cache hits and live calls separately

stages.name: SteamDB cache load and mechanical classification
requirements: load steamdb_history at most once
use actual len(entries), not stale metadata entry_count
classify confirmed_min, previously_free, valid negative cache, and true lookup misses
do not perform SteamDB lookup in this stage

stages.name: SteamDB lookups for true history misses only
requirements: lookup only canonical true misses
never repeat exact provider/entity key in run
do not persist timeout/tool failure as negative history
track confirmed minima, previously free, unavailable exact history, and blocked/failures separately

stages.name: SteamDB cache checkpoint
requirements: at most one GitHub write if changed
repair metadata on permitted write
do not store guessed minima
write failure follows canonical warning-only behavior

stages.name: Deal quality and deterministic sort
requirements: taste is already final and cannot be raised by deal quality
historical zero is not used as paid minimum delta
apply canonical purchase decision order and within-decision sort
no artificial top-N

stages.name: Freebies, upcoming event, and mailing render
requirements: freebies use personal filter and only run after successful main ingest
upcoming has at most one relevant event within canonical horizon
render only included recommendations
do not publish yet

stages.name: Canonical final self-check
requirements: verify every canonical final_self_check assertion
verify all diagnostic stages 01 through 19 are PASS
verify complete downstream ledger
only PASS here permits production publication
